data: Is the maximum height of the dark grey line higher than that of the light grey line?

The caption states that the dark grey line represents the distribution of distances between related pairs, while the light grey line represents the distribution of distances between non-related pairs. The question asks whether the maximum height of the dark grey line is higher than that of the light grey line. From the analysis of the figure, the dark grey line appears to be consistently above the light grey line across the entire range of normalized distance values. This suggests that the maximum height of the dark grey line is indeed higher than that of the light grey line. Therefore, the answer is yes.
